headline: Weather Alert: Maritime ports asked to hoist cautionary signal no 3
summary: Authorities have issued a warning for maritime ports to raise signal number 3 as weather conditions deteriorate.
details: Maritime ports in Bangladesh have been instructed to hoist cautionary signal number 3.
This signal is typically issued when wind speeds increase and sea conditions become rougher, warning ships and sailors of potential danger.
Port authorities and maritime operators are now on high alert to ensure the safety of vessels and vessels' movements.
Local residents in coastal areas are also advised to remain vigilant as the weather warning is updated by the meteorological department.

headline_marked: Man arrested after [[attempted rape of 12-year-old student]] in Rajbari
headline: Man arrested after attempted rape of 12-year-old student in Rajbari
summary: A man was handed over to police by an angry mob after allegedly attempting to rape a sixth-grade madrasa student in Pangsha Upazila.
details: A man identified as Jillu Mondal was arrested in Rajbari's Pangsha Upazila following allegations that he attempted to rape a 12-year-old madrasa student.
The incident occurred last Monday morning while the sixth-grade student was walking to her madrasa through a dirt road in a sugarcane field.
According to reports, the suspect grabbed the girl and covered her mouth, but he fled the scene after nearby people gathered upon hearing her screams.
On Tuesday, local residents confronted the suspect at the madrasa premises, where he was beaten by an angry crowd demanding justice.
To prevent further violence, the suspect was locked in a room at the madrasa until Pangsha police arrived and took him into custody around 12:30 PM.
The victim's father has filed an attempted rape case at the Pangsha Model Police Station.
Officer-in-Charge Sheikh Moinul Islam confirmed that the suspect was sent to court on Tuesday afternoon following legal procedures.
caption:
A 12-year-old student was targeted in a sugarcane field in Rajbari. The suspect was later beaten by a mob before being handed to police.

A man identified as Jillu Mondal was arrested in Rajbari's Pangsha Upazila following allegations that he attempted to rape a 12-year-old madrasa student.

The incident occurred last Monday morning while the sixth-grade student was walking to her madrasa through a dirt road in a sugarcane field.

According to reports, the suspect grabbed the girl and covered her mouth, but he fled the scene after nearby people gathered upon hearing her screams.

On Tuesday, local residents confronted the suspect at the madrasa premises, where he was beaten by an angry crowd demanding justice.

To prevent further violence, the suspect was locked in a room at the madrasa until Pangsha police arrived and took him into custody around 12:30 PM.

The victim's father has filed an attempted rape case at the Pangsha Model Police Station.

Officer-in-Charge Sheikh Moinul Islam confirmed that the suspect was sent to court on Tuesday afternoon following legal procedures.
